column1: # Extra edge cases beyond the suggested data. Suggested run:
# seq 3 arrives first and must wait (this debit would overdraw if applied before the credits)
# exact redelivery of the same request (same requestId) -> ignored as replay
# reversal of TXN-3002 (credit 50); balance is 40 after seq 3 -> would overdraw -> INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
# a debit on an empty account
# bad currency + too many decimals -> validation failure; its readable sequence (7) is closed so the stream continues
# seq 10 arrives but 9 never does -> stays PENDING and is reported as a gap
# malformed row (wrong column count) -> rejected in isolation
